title: Group Fitness Class Passes: habitual no-show threshold, measurement window and suspension length by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Group Fitness Class Passes product line. For each class-credit pack tier, it states the number of no-shows within a trailing window that counts as habitual, the length of that trailing window, and the number of days booking privileges are suspended once the threshold is crossed.

## Basis by tier
Each tier fixes a threshold count of no-shows; each tier fixes the number of trailing days over which no-shows are counted toward that threshold; and each tier fixes the number of days booking privileges are suspended once the threshold is reached. These three figures are independent per tier and are read together to determine when a suspension basis is met.

| Tier | No-show threshold (count) | Measurement window (days) | Suspension length (days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5-Class Pack | 3 | 60 | 14 |
| 10-Class Pack | 3 | 60 | 14 |
| 20-Class Pack | 4 | 60 | 14 |
| Unlimited Monthly Classes | 3 | 45 | 7 |
| Specialty Studio Pack | 3 | 90 | 21 |
| Founding Class Pass | 4 | 60 | 7 |

## Points of judgement
- The 20-Class Pack and Founding Class Pass require one more no-show (4) than the other tiers (3) before the threshold is reached, over the same or a different window.
- The Specialty Studio Pack pairs the longest measurement window (90 days) with the longest suspension (21 days); the Unlimited Monthly Classes tier pairs the shortest measurement window (45 days) with the shortest suspension (7 days).
